messages:
alex_k: Starting schema-swap deploy now in the 22:00 UTC maintenance window. Migration plan uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/migrations/mig-4723456789. Note: backfill will run across replicas, using token-based rate limiting.

deploy-bot: deploy started for migration job migration-2026-03-21-01 id=mig-4723456789. Status: queued -> running on db-cluster-replica-3

jamie: Noted. Can we pin app version 3.14.2 to avoid new auth changes? @maria_g

maria_g: Yes, I'll pin the release; doing the version toggle now. /release pin service-web 3.14.2

deploy-bot: /release pin completed for service-web -> 3.14.2

alex_k: Observed read-replica lag increasing on monitor. eng-sre please confirm: replicas: r1=2s r2=3s r3=25s

eng-sre: r3 is spiking, looks like backfill worker burst. We're enabling soft-throttle token to 50 rps. Applying now. :wrench:

peter_s: Also lowering chunk size from 10k -> 1k for backfill to reduce lock durations.

alex_k: Good. If r3 lag > 60s we abort backfill and resume holes. What's abort command?

eng-sre: Command: kubectl exec -it backfill-controller -- /bin/sh -c 'POST /abort?job=mig-4723456789'  (we have a script in ops/abort_backfill.sh)

jamie: If we abort, can we resume where left off? Need idempotency check.

maria_g: Backfill supports checkpoints; resume will pick last committed PK. Ops note: don't re-run schema-apply until backfill checkpoint is healthy.

deploy-bot: Migration job mig-4723456789: progress 37% rows processed 12,345,678 locks acquired 42. Current state: running.

eng-sre: After throttle applied, r3 lag dropped to 12s. Good to continue but keep chunk size and tokens.

alex_k: OK plan: continue for next 10 minutes, reassess. If lag >30s again, abort. @deploy-bot add tag 'watchdog:10m'

deploy-bot: tag added to mig-4723456789 -> watchdog:10m. I'll post status updates every 2m.

jamie: Also adding release-note blurb: 'DB migration: user_preferences column rename, backfill performed with throttling to avoid replica lag'. I'll PR now.

maria_g: PR merged, release notes updated. :sparkles:

eng-sre: Final checkin: no further lag. r1=2s r2=3s r3=9s. Keep throttle in place until end of window.

alex_k: Thanks all. If anything changes, ping this thread. I'll mark canary done and schedule final cutover 23:15 UTC. :thumbsup:
